headline: Frequent Rework of Live Functionality
diagnosis: The commit history indicates a recurring theme of issues related to the live display functionality, particularly around threading and refresh mechanisms. Frequent fixes for deadlocks, double progress, and thread safety suggest that the implementation is fragile and prone to errors.
plan: Conduct a thorough code review of the `_RefreshThread` and `Live` class to identify potential race conditions and deadlock scenarios.
Implement comprehensive unit tests focused on the threading behavior and refresh logic to ensure stability under various conditions.
Refactor the threading model if necessary, possibly considering alternatives to improve thread safety and reduce complexity.
Establish a clear ownership of the live functionality to ensure accountability for future changes and maintenance.
owner_hint: Assign a dedicated engineer to oversee the live display feature.
